req.title: Task title max length
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title exceeds the maximum length constraint.

doc.reasoning: The violation was test[2] having kind=negative but heuristic=BVA. The rule requires that a negative kind must not use BVA as its heuristic. The fix is to change test[2] (title of 101 chars, rejected with 422) to kind=boundary, which is semantically correct: a value exactly one step over the boundary is a boundary-value test, not a generic negative test. All other tests are preserved unchanged. The full set remains: (1) EP positive at 50 chars, (2) BVA boundary at exactly 100 chars accepted, (3) BVA boundary at exactly 101 chars rejected — now correctly kind=boundary, (4) BVA boundary at exactly 99 chars accepted, (5) NEG negative at 500 chars rejected, (6) NEG negative at empty string rejected.

tests.name: test_create_task_valid_title_within_limit
expected: response body contains id, title, completed=false
trace: R-TASK-029 — valid partition: title length 50 is well within max_length=100
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, engine

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)
title_50 = "A" * 50
r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": title_50, "completed": False})
assert r.status_code == 201
body = r.json()
assert body["title"] == title_50
assert body["completed"] == False
assert "id" in body
assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
